title: Honeycomb Column
description: JSON Schema for the Honeycomb Column resource. Generated from the Honeycomb API OpenAPI spec.

type.description: Type of data that the Column will contain. Histogram is in beta and only works in your Metrics dataset.

hidden.description: If `true`, the column is excluded from autocomplete and raw data field lists.

id.description: Unique identifier (ID), returned in response bodies.

last_written.description: ISO8601 formatted time the column was last written to (received event data).

created_at.description: ISO8601 formatted time the column was created.

updated_at.description: ISO8601 formatted time the column was updated.
